# go-modern-slices-sort-func

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.SortFunc with cmp.Compare instead of sort.Slice for typed comparisons.

## Details

slices.SortFunc compares typed elements directly, avoiding sort.Slice closures that index back into the slice. cmp.Compare is the usual comparator for ordered fields.

## Examples

### Before

```go
sort.Slice(items, func(i, j int) bool {
  return items[i].X < items[j].X
})
```

### After

```go
slices.SortFunc(items, func(a, b Item) int {
  return cmp.Compare(a.X, b.X)
})
```

Source: [https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json](https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json)
